answer: Tati's Barbershop hours depend on the day and barber availability. Check the booking screen for live open slots, or ask the front desk when you arrive for a walk-in.
Walk-ins are welcome. Use the kiosk or receptionist queue for regular or exclusive services. You'll see your place in line and when a barber can start.
Book from the app: pick a barber, service, date, and time slot. After a face scan you can attach your chosen style preview to the appointment.
The face scan captures front, left, and right photos. We analyze your face shape and hair length, then you can tap a style to generate an AI preview (this uses credits and may take a few minutes).
Set your hair texture in profile (Straight, Wavy, or Curly). Recommendations and the library filter styles to match your texture.
Service prices are shown when you select a haircut and barber. Complete payment in the app flow after choosing your slot.
Open the Appointments to view upcoming bookings. Cancel or change according to the options shown there, or contact the shop if you need help.
Visit Tati's Barbershop at our shop location shown in your booking confirmation or shop signage.
